name: The review opens on the person's own lines and no coaching record exists to cite, the placed check-in's counts as never review context, "you really have talent" at the review, and feedback that never touches pay
markdown_description:
**Routed to:** S13 (`86ajgmjey`)

Session 12 designed the coaching model so that its only residue is the person's own check-in line: a lead's hypothesis has no page, a lead's observation is spoken and unwritten, no written recap of a hard-feedback conversation exists, failure types sit on process updates and never on a person, and the placed, extended, and moved check-in counts are load readings on a lead's windows and never a read of any person. Session 13 inherits: the review "never contains new information" (WP p.19) because it opens on the person page's lines and on nothing else, and a review that contains something not on the page is a candor failure read on the lead's entry and not a diligence lapse, which Session 12 named as the enforcement of candor and Session 13 writes as its row; the review may cite no coaching record, no failure-type count, no placed-check-in count, no recognition decline, no half-page "routed" mark, and no re-training trigger beyond the training record's state, in the same way Session 9 refused the evidence line in a managing-out decision (S9 P42); her "You really have talent" said "as part of a formal process" (Book p.384) is the review's to answer, with the check-in's first question and the peer's recognition already carrying the informal half; and no feedback act of any kind is a pay input, a fifth dimension, or an input to the point system, extending `86akh67yb` (the review's rhythm and no-surprises evidence base), `86akh5uwq`'s S13 half, `86akh3wxv`'s S13 half, and `17tn048qc2c` and not repeating them. High.

Filed by Session 12 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmjba`. Reasoning lives on the S12 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
